verdict.rationale: Clara's marketing site claims 'automated expense reporting, approvals and compliance', so approval workflows are part of the product. Nothing in the evidence describes configurable multi-step chains (manager → budget owner → finance), delegation, or escalation when approvers stall. The only evidence is a single thin marketing mention. Missing for 10: documented multi-step approval chain configuration, approver delegation, escalation/timeout rules, first-party docs depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.
